title: In-chat search still matches pages by a generation counter (begin_query/ request_chat_search(search_gen))
trigger: type a query, change query while page in flight
effect: late page of old query matched by counter not RequestId

title: History calendar pages matched by SearchPurpose::GetChatMessageCalendar{generation} counter
trigger: open calendar, switch media tab while page in flight

title: Bot create/check username answers matched by generation counters (CheckBotUsername/CreateBot purposes)
trigger: type username, retype while check out

title: PasskeyAdd::FetchingOptions(request) and Create Passkey never checks the request still exists in session.requests (the list stage does); a lost request leaves begin_register returning Ok(None) forever
trigger: click Create Passkey, connection drops so request is lost without answer
effect: Create Passkey spins until app restart

title: fetch_blocked_senders asks from offset = loaded length, so the "always fresh" fetch on every Privacy open never refetches page 0 once the list is loaded (and after a chat-bar Block on an unloaded list it starts at offset 1, skipping the server's first entry)
trigger: load Settings > Privacy > Blocked, block a user from another device (or block from a chat while the list is unloaded), reopen Privacy
effect: blocked list stays stale until restart; the newest server entry is never shown; has_more can stay true with a duplicate-only page
fix: offset 0 refetch on open (Fetch::Outdated) with page request tied to RequestId

title: A refused send of getStickerCategories leaves sticker_categories Idle (GetStickerCategories is not in StickerLists::for_purpose, so sticker_request cannot fail it) although the doc says a failed ask stays Failed so a render never re-asks; the panel's render-deferred fetch re-sends on every render
trigger: open sticker panel while the client refuses sends (closing client)
effect: a new getStickerCategories attempt on each render of the panel and no Failed/Retry state
fix: fail the Fetch in fetch_sticker_categories on Err

title: StickerManager::open is a session bool mirroring whether the manager box is on screen, set and cleared by hand from the UI (stickers_manager/mod.rs, masks_ui.rs) beside the box's own state; covers_requested is cleared only with it
trigger: open stickers manager, switch account or close the window without the box's close path
effect: manager.open stays true so pump_sticker_manager keeps downloading covers
fix: derive from the box (OnScreen) instead of a session flag

title: WebApps::opening is one account-wide slot: a launch from a second window overwrites the first window's still-pending launch (its answer opens nothing and its app is closed) although the launches belong to different windows
trigger: tap a mini app in the main window and another in a chat window before the first answers
effect: the first window's mini app silently never opens
fix: per-window launch stage keyed by RequestId

title: Widget query answers are matched by a caller-held u64 token in BotsPurpose::GetWidgetQueryAnswer instead of the RequestId (counter: baseline)
trigger: widget sends two queries while the first is out
effect: answer routed by counter not by request
fix: key the widget answer by RequestId

title: A keyword query that failed ATTEMPTS (2) times is given up for the whole session; failures are never reset by reconnect/online, so queries tried offline never complete after the network returns
trigger: type :smile style emoji search while offline twice then go online
effect: that query never shows keyword emoji until restart
fix: clear failures when the connection becomes Ready (or hold the query in a Failed stage with a retry clock)

title: The sticker, GIF and emoji panels each keep an `open` bool in the Session (StickerPanel::open, gifs.open, EmojiPanel::open) set by open_*_panel and cleared by close_*_panel; refresh_stale_panels and maybe_load_selected_sticker_set read it to decide what to refetch, so a panel dismissed by a path that skips close_* keeps work running while hidden
trigger: open the sticker panel then lock, switch account or close the window without the panel's close path
effect: stale-list refetches and set loads keep going for a panel nobody sees
fix: derive from the picker owned by OnScreen/ChatUi (one value), no session mirror

title: TrendingSets::Loading holds `request: Option<RequestId>` that is None between begin() and sent(): an Option used as a "went out" flag, so a caller that begins and neither sends nor fails leaves a Loading nothing can answer
trigger: emoji sets Trending tab asks while the send path returns early
effect: Loading stage with no request until a manual fail/cancel
fix: begin_with(request) after the send, or Fetch::Loading{request}

title: KeywordEmojis is one session-wide value read by every window's emoji panel through for_query: two windows searching different queries overwrite each other's list and ask again on each switch
trigger: search emoji in two windows with different words
effect: results disappear in one window when the other types

title: EarnState keeps one-shot slots (open_url: Option<String>, notes, effects) the UI is expected to drain; nothing clears them when the page or window that asked is gone, so a Fragment URL set after the user left the Withdraw box opens later in an unrelated frame
trigger: start a withdrawal, close the revenue page before the answer lands
effect: a browser tab opens or toast appears long after the action
fix: a stage on the Withdraw (Opened{url}) owned by the page

title: set_chat_sound/show_preview/story_* each clone chat.notification_settings from the session and send the whole object, so two changes made before updateChatNotificationSettings returns send the second from the old copy and undo the first
trigger: change a chat's sound then its preview within one round trip
fix: send only the changed field or hold a Saving stage with the pending settings

title: set_gift_settings stores the on-screen value as the rollback before the optimistic write; a second save before the first answers records the first optimistic value as the one to restore, so a refusal of the first restores a value the server never held
trigger: toggle two gift-privacy switches quickly while the server refuses the first
effect: a refused change shows as applied or the wrong value is restored
fix: keep the server-confirmed value in the stage and restore to it
